S: Account local archive temporary storage without changing encoded semantics or byte accounting.

required: full SQLite page-cap reservation before opening writable databases
no early release of live allocations
CM1.measurement: logical file lengths plus reserved native database and directory recovery journal capacities
CM1.typed_refusal: HELD_SCRATCH_*; no publication on quota failure

IR.readonly_lookup_reopen: only exact owned database URI; guarded read plans
IR.uncertain_write: poison further growth and retain reservation
IR.internal_realization_receipt: BEFORE_AUDIT_SERIALIZATION_AND_PUBLICATION; retained separately and charged in public final receipt
IR.public_result_root: COVERS_FINAL_RESOURCES_AND_RECOVERY; realization_receipt_sha256 identifies original on-disk receipt
IR.directory_recovery: EXPLICIT_ROOT_AND_TARGET_QUARANTINE; no automatic rollback or power-failure claim
IR.cleanup: release after deletion/close; local publication transfers ownership
